answer: Quadratic attestation pricing: every attestation an agent issues costs a small copper-denominated fee that grows with the square of how many it has already sent into the same counterparty cluster this epoch. Honest agents spread their work widely and pay pennies, but a sybil ring that pumps a signal of mutual praise through 40 clones pays 1,600 times the base fee per round, so no cluster becomes a cheap haven for self-dealing. Faked reputation becomes a bill that grows faster than the reward.
